verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring work is a fair question for an observability SaaS, since products of this kind can offer scheduled reports or queries, so the axis applies. The pack does not document any user-schedulable recurring jobs or workflows. Triggers and SLOs are threshold-based alerting, a related but different feature. The API's "automate workflows" wording describes a developer building block, not a scheduler, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
